messages:
Jared: Thanks everyone — quick live Q&A follow-up from today's all-hands on finance/runway. Drop questions here and Maya/Carlos will answer live.
Maya: Hi all, I'll start with the headline numbers people asked about.
Sam: can we get the burn number again? rough monthly and run rate pls.
Maya: Sure — current cash burn ~ $3.2M/month (net of committed Dedicated revenue). That implies ~18 months of runway on current balance and commitments. :bar_chart:
Asha: does that account for the Dedicated capacity revenue we forecast next quarter?
Maya: Yes — the 18 months assumes conservative ramp for Dedicated. If bookings hit plan, runway extends to ~22–24 months.
Priya: what are the biggest levers if we need to extend runway quickly? where would cuts come from first?
Carlos: We prioritize product investment and customer-facing ops — short-term levers: hiring pause for noncritical roles, slow down brand/marketing spend, tighten vendor contracts, and aggressive contract negotiations for cloud & GPU spend.
Lina: hiring pause clarification? does that mean freeze across the company or selective?
Carlos: Selective. Critical roles (SRE, infra, customer-critical PM/SE) proceed with approvals. All other reqs need VP + Finance signoff.
Sam: procurement changes? last-minute infra purchases have been causing spikes.
ProcurementBot: New procurement workflow deployed today: purchases > $5k require Finance approval; purchases > $50k require Legal + CFO signoff. Submit via https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-123 (use the "expedited" tag for customer-impacting buys).
Jared: We also updated the approval matrix in Confluence — please read before approving vendor charges.
Priya: curious about capital vs operating classification — any plan to buy hardware (capex) to save on cloud opex?
Maya: We're evaluating hybrid: selective on-prem GPU racks where TCO looks favorable for steady long-term Dedicated pools. Any on-prem spend will go through a multi-week ROI review and board notification if > $250k initial spend.
Asha: forecasting: do teams need to re-forecast their Q2 budgets?
Carlos: Yes — we pushed a refresh. All team leads: update Q2 forecast in the finance sheet by EOD next Friday. Templates in #finance-docs.
Sam: will there be discretionary spend pools left for hackdays/critical tooling?
Maya: Small discretionary pool remains but centrally managed. Requests under $2k can be approved by managers; $2k–$5k by Directors + Finance.
Priya: procurement timeline — how long for approvals now? we've seen 2–3 week delays.
ProcurementBot: Standard SLA: 3 business days for <$5k, 7 business days for $5k–$50k, escalations available for "expedited" flag with product/service owner + finance sponsor.
Lina: benefits or people ops spend impacted? hiring-related costs?
Carlos: No changes to headcount benefits. People Ops discretionary budgets will be slightly reduced; major programs will be reviewed case-by-case.
Jared: big picture — this is about being prudent while we invest in the product. We have margin to be aggressive on customer growth where it pays off.
Asha: will we communicate any of this externally (customers/partners)?
Jared: No external comms planned. This is internal operating guidance only.
Sam: any changes to dollar-denominated quotas/compensation?
Maya: No compensation changes today. We aim to avoid compensation cuts.
Priya: follow-up: who do we ask for an exception if a procurement is time-sensitive and > $50k?
Carlos: Exception process: raise in the procurement ticket, tag @Maya and @Jared, include customer impact justification and rollback plan. We will triage within 24 hours for true customer-impacting cases.
Sam: ok thanks — super helpful.
Jared: Thanks all. We'll post the updated approval matrix + procurement playbook to #finance-docs and the all-hands notes. If anyone needs 1:1 clarification, DM Maya or Carlos. :thumbsup:
Maya: Added a short FAQ in Confluence and a sample procurement request template under the ticket link.
ProcurementBot: Reminder: all outstanding vendor contracts expiring in next 90 days have been auto-flagged; vendors with auto-renewal > $10k will get a hold until review completes.
Priya: noted, will check the flagged list.
Lina: appreciate the clarity — will include this in new-hire onboarding updates.
Jared: Closing the thread — we may revisit if the board asks for changes.
